office_does: The prosecuting attorney charges and tries crimes in Lewis County courts and is the legal adviser to the county commissioners and departments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Jonathan L. Meyer (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate and submitted no voters' guide statement.

candidates.summary: Lewis County Prosecuting Attorney, unopposed in 2014, 2018 and 2022; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Submitted no statement to the 2026 voters' guide [S1]
